questions.question_text: The line 2x + 3y = 12 crosses the x-axis at P and the y-axis at Q. Find the coordinates of P and the coordinates of Q.
A is the point (-2, 5) and B is the point (4, -1). Find the column vector of the translation from point A to point B.
Find the coordinates of the mid-point of AB.
Find the magnitude of \begin{pmatrix} 7 \\ 9 \end{pmatrix}.
The line L has gradient 3 and passes through the point (-2, 7). Find the equation of line L. Give your answer in the form y = mx + c.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) for values of x between -5 and 3.
On the diagram, draw the asymptote to the graph of y = f(x).
Solve the equation f(x) = -1.
Solve the equation f(x) = x^2 - 1.
Solve the inequality f(x) < x^2 - 1.
Write 1 \frac{1}{25} as a percentage.
In a sale, all prices are reduced by 15%. Lola buys a jacket which has an original price of $64. Calculate the sale price of this jacket.
Nina invests $x at a rate of 1.8% per year compound interest. At the end of 3 years the value of this investment is $3375.93, correct to the nearest cent. Calculate the value of x.

Olav buys a car for $13000. Each year the value of the car decreases by 12% of its value in the previous year. Calculate the number of complete years it takes for the value of Olav's car to first become less than $5000.
Show that the total volume of the shape is 537 cm^3, correct to 3 significant figures.
The shape is melted and all the metal is used to make 600 identical small cubes. Calculate the side length of one of these cubes. Give your answer in millimetres.
The diagram shows a sector OAB with radius r cm and centre O. The sector angle is 120°. The shaded segment has an area of 18.4 cm^2. Calculate the length of the arc AB.
Find the value of v when u = 7, a = 1.5 and s = 10.
Rearrange the formula to write u in terms of v, a and s.
Complete the table for sequences A, B and C.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle T onto triangle P.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle T onto triangle Q.
Stretch triangle T by factor 2 with invariant line x = 5.
Show this inequality on the number line.
Solve the inequality -7 \leqslant 2x + 1 < 5.
Write down the integers that satisfy the inequality -7 \leqslant 2x + 1 < 5.
Show that y^2 - 4y - 5 = 0.
Solve by factorisation y^2 - 4y - 5 = 0.
Calculate AD.
Calculate angle DAB.
Calculate CD.
The point P lies on BC and is the nearest point to D. Calculate BP.
D is due north of B. Calculate the bearing of C from A.
Find f(-2).
Find the exact value of g(120).
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = g(x) for values of x between 0° and 180°.
Find x when h(x) = 82.
Find h^{-1}(x).
Simplify fully f(x) - \frac{1}{f(x)}. Give your answer as a single fraction.
Calculate an estimate of the mean.
One of the plants is chosen at random. Find the probability that the plant has a height greater than 15 cm.
Two of the 100 plants are chosen at random without replacement. Find the probability that one plant has a height of 15 cm or less and one has a height greater than 30 cm.
Complete the Venn diagram.
Write down the number of students who like football and swimming.
One of the 50 students is chosen at random. Find the probability that this student likes football or swimming but not both.
Two of the students who like swimming are chosen at random. Find the probability that they both like football.
Rationalise the denominator \frac{3}{\sqrt{a} - 1}.
(g + h\sqrt{3})(h - g\sqrt{3}) = p + q\sqrt{3}. Find p and q in terms of g and h.
d is an integer. Work out 3 \times 10^d + 3 \times 10^{d-2}, giving your answer in standard form.
Find \sqrt[3]{8 \times 10^{2000}}. Give your answer in standard form.
